# esptool-js 0.6.1 (vendored)

`bundle.js` is the unmodified single-file build from the npm package
[`esptool-js@0.6.1`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/esptool-js) (Espressif, Apache-2.0, see `LICENSE`).
It includes the flasher stubs for every chip, so flashing works without loading anything from a CDN.

sha256 `ef7d5a237d3f273ecf546bcee65dddad90bd82cf02f22a980d1537e0cd79a152`

To update: `npm pack esptool-js@<version>`, copy `package/bundle.js` and `package/LICENSE` here,
update the version and checksum above, and check `web/robocore_usb.js` against the new API.
